parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the application that you want to delete. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description: Specifies whether to forcibly delete the application and disable application deletion protection.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas delete-k8s-application --app-id dbac7e3c-0000-49bc-b6de-ffc550018b45 --biz-force true --region cn-hangzhou
